root_causes.name: prompt_patch_mismatch_bug
root_causes.description: Prompt patching uses exact-match comparison. When an existing submitted workflow is loaded, its text differs from the payload stub, so comparison fails and prompts remain unchanged.

evidence.expected_positive: A professional cinematic shot of a person in an office, high quality, 8k
evidence.actual_positive: Alya, beautiful young woman with long flowing silver hair, wearing elegant white flowing dress, standing in sun-dappled forest clearing surrounded by colorful wildflowers, soft golden light filtering through canopy, dreamlike atmosphere, peaceful contemplative expression gazing at distant mountain peak, cinematic lighting, photorealistic, highly detailed, masterpiece, 8k, serene forest setting
evidence.actual_negative: ugly, deformed, noisy, blurry, distorted, out of focus, bad anatomy, extra limbs, missing limbs, floating limbs, disconnected limbs, mutation, mutated, watermark, text, signature, grain, oversaturated, dark, harsh lighting, urban, buildings, modern, weapons, violence

root_causes.recommendation: Replace exact-match prompt patching with unconditional overwrite or add a force-inject flag.

root_causes.name: cross_shot_workflow_reuse
root_causes.description: The corrective retry loaded an existing submitted workflow from a different shot (shot01) instead of the target shot's workflow, causing wrong prompts and context.
root_causes.recommendation: Ensure corrective retry loads the target shot's submitted workflow, not the first available submitted workflow.

root_causes.name: empty_lora_stack
root_causes.description: LoraLoader node exists but lora_stack is empty, so no LoRA adjustments are applied.
root_causes.recommendation: Remove unused LoraLoader node or populate lora_stack with intended LoRAs.

root_causes.name: missing_ip_adapter_and_controlnet
root_causes.description: No IPAdapter or ControlNet nodes present, limiting pose, style, and composition control.
root_causes.recommendation: Add IPAdapter or ControlNet nodes if the recipe requires composition control.
